task: FORECASTBUNDLE RESEARCH GOVERNANCE DECISION RECORD D5 - DEMAND FORECAST SOURCE

governance_decision_d5.name: Demand Forecast Source - Deferred Future Capability
governance_decision_d5.statement: POLARIS shall not currently designate the existing prototype demand mechanism as the authoritative demand-forecast source. Demand forecasting shall remain a deferred future research and engineering capability.

current_demand_source_evidence.forecasting_mechanism: Persistence of last observed demand with cosine diurnal wave: max(10000.0, last_obs_demand + 3000.0 * cos(h * pi / 12))
current_demand_source_evidence.category: Prototype persistence heuristic with diurnal cosine peak simulation
current_demand_source_evidence.empirical_validation: None. Has never undergone empirical training or benchmarking on station load data.

architecture_vs_capability.architectural_structure: INTACT. ForecastBundle schema v1.0 defines required demand field in W.
architecture_vs_capability.technical_prototype: PRESENT (UNVALIDATED). LocalBaselineForecastEngine generates synthetic cosine persistence curve.
architecture_vs_capability.research_capability: DEFERRED. Dedicated, validated demand forecasting model not yet developed.
architecture_vs_capability.governance_authorization: NOT AUTHORIZED. Baseline prototype not authorized as an integration source.

reason_for_deferral: Strict scientific provenance; prototype heuristic does not constitute a trained demand forecasting model.
High-resolution measured polar station electrical demand data access is restricted (REAL DATA ACCESS RESTRICTED).
Demand forecasting depends on building physics, occupant schedules, and heating loads distinct from solar irradiance.

d5_frozen_contract_assessment.reasoning: ForecastBundle schema v1.0 retains demand field. Deferring the demand forecast source does not require a structural schema modification.

scientific_claim_limitations: Records capability status and governance only. Does not claim demand forecasting skill, load availability, or EMS optimization validity under real demand.
